modalities.evidence: This is the fMRI data from Miyawaki et al.

output.population: Two human subjects viewing contrast-based flickering patch images (random image viewing and figure image viewing runs).
output.summary: fMRI data from two subjects viewing contrast-based images of 12 x 12 flickering patches, in random and figure image viewing tasks, used to train and evaluate multiscale local image decoders that reconstruct presented stimuli.
